evidence.observation: O2 begins rising from ~5 ppm at end of ramp to 13.5 ppm at growth onset
Monotonic O2 climb through growth: 13.5→23.9→30.9→38.3→47.4→54.5 ppm, unlike the steady low-ppm baseline expected after purge
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rising O2 is not from a gas-supply change
Temperature holds at 750 °C with plausible heater power; thermal control looks normal
Pressure gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere/leak-up cannot be confirmed directly

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure/leak-up measurement (gauge is not installed) or an Ar-flow step test to see whether O2 dilutes as expected; otherwise post-run seal inspection and characterization of the film.
